\(600(1.00575)^{13}+1000(1.00575)^7 \approx 1687.3814\).

Part B:

Probability at least two share \(=1-\frac{42}{220}=\frac{89}{110}\).

- 9-hour days: \(8+1.5=9.5\) each, 3 days

Total equivalent hours \(=3(16)+3(9.5)+12.5+5(8)+2(6)=141\).  
Gross pay \(=141(24.75)=3489.75\).
